Complete white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha comparisons show genuine exterior transparency around the complete card/frame/note silhouette, opaque person/backing/frame/note interiors and no visible interior holes or lost photographic backing. Internal 252-254 values are not automatic rejection grounds; actual visible review passes the current visible-alpha policy. No alpha-only derivation or source-alpha replacement was performed.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine individual note-stroke endpoints, tiny eyewear/temple details, breast decorations and readable note glyphs cannot be resolved at 65x67. Approval relies on plainly visible group structure, relative lengths, tab shape, preserved person/clothing and the complete visible Alpha comparison, not guessed text.
